verdict.rationale: Devin is itself a coding agent, so this axis would normally be na. However, the docs describe a first-party Devin MCP server that gives "any MCP-compatible AI agent or IDE" access to session management, playbooks, knowledge, and scheduling, and a probe confirms an official MCP server page. That makes the axis applicable, and the core story is delivered. missing for 10: setup, authentication and transport details for connecting an agent; tool-level reference documentation; independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server working.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: it gives any MCP-compatible AI agent or IDE full access to session management, playbooks, knowledge, and scheduling
